Saved run status

Shared Euler/HEM model, zero wall friction and heating, equilibrium bicubic JAXProp properties. Generated 2 November 2026. Unsuccessful attempts remain unfinished; their errors are not validation conclusions.

5 of 5 finest-grid cases converged. Their pressure RMSE spans 3.345–4.310 bar. These errors measure agreement with the experiment; the residual tolerances measure the discrete root.

Liquid fraction and measured condensation onset

The dotted lines show measured condensation locations, not computed onset. Only L1/L5 have reference CFD liquid-fraction curves; no experimental fraction samples are supplied. The saved raw JAXProp quality Q is mapped to 1−Q only when finite and between 0 and 1. Sentinels such as −1 and out-of-range interpolation values remain gaps, without clipping.

L1: N=96, 1 masked samples, raw Q range 0.908071 to 1.001355; L2: N=96, 1 masked samples, raw Q range 0.862994 to 1.001305; L3: N=96, 0 masked samples, raw Q range 0.820039 to 1.000000; L4: N=96, 0 masked samples, raw Q range 0.764007 to 1.000000; L5: N=96, 0 masked samples, raw Q range 0.697291 to 1.000000.

No threshold-based predicted onset is claimed from these interpolated equilibrium diagnostics.

Limits and provenance

The source is Lettieri et al., DOI 10.1115/1.4038082, 2018 issue, online 2017. Appendix Tables 2/3 supply first-repeat conditions and pressures for all five cases. Original L1/L5 Excel and CFD series came from Andrea revision bcfe6ae1ec8abd71528e57b218ac8291dc9461fa. L2–L4 exact tap coordinates and CFD series remain unavailable; nominal tap coordinates are explicitly approximate. No measurement uncertainty is invented.

The measured half-height spline uses x=-z from Appendix Table 4; its inlet half-height is corrected from the workbook's 6.38 mm to the publication's 6.35 mm. Depth is 6.48 mm as in Andrea, consistent with the primary 20 mm² throat area divided by the full throat height. Full-channel mass flow is 2 times depth times the half-channel per-depth flow; their units are kg/s and kg/(s m), respectively. Experimental mass flow is not supplied.

HEM imposes phase equilibrium; the experiment contains delayed condensation. Solver convergence, physical budgets and experimental agreement are separate checks. No CFD field was used as initialization.
